description: Seed a repository with DiffCI agent instruction files, MCP server configs, the diffci-verify skill and the pre-push hook.

hook.description: Install the Git pre-push hook that verifies the commits being pushed (default true).

mcp.description: Register the DiffCI MCP server in .mcp.json and .cursor/mcp.json (default true).

repo.description: Repository path. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

skill.description: Add the diffci-verify skill to .claude/skills (default true).

verificationWorkflow.description: Also add the blocking GitHub Actions verification workflow.

workflow.description: Also add the non-blocking GitHub Actions observer workflow.

name: diffci_init
